name: Sonyeoui 1-geub Bimil ~Deoghu Jung-ui Deoghu~
source:
t was an ordinary day…when I met my Favorite Star like it was destiny.

It was the day when I got my soul and wallet stolen by a popular K-Pop idol group, Pandora, but I was still happy to have him in my heart.

However, on the comeback date of my totally gorgeous Favorite Star, I accidentally bumped into 5 guys, and my secret life as a hardcore fangirl gets revealed to the world!
translation:
这是一个平凡的一天……当我遇到我最喜欢的明星时，就像这是命运一样。

那一天，我的灵魂和钱包被韩国流行偶像组合潘多拉偷走了，但我仍然很高兴有他在我的心里。

然而，在我最喜欢的明星的回归日，我不小心撞到了5个男人，我作为铁杆女粉丝的秘密生活被揭露给了全世界！
